title: KutzInventory auction scan
description: One auction house's prices from one scan, written by tools/inventory_export.js (auction-scans.json holds an array of these) and sent by the Companion to POST /api/wow/auctions. It names no character, GUID or account. Prices are unit prices in copper; times are ISO-8601 UTC. An item missing from `items` is unknown unless scope is all and the scan is complete; `p: []` means it was searched and none were listed.

schemaVersion.description: A reader that knows 1.0 can read any 1.x.

region.description: From GetCurrentRegion(); "us" when the game did not say.

realm.description: Exactly as GetRealmName() returns it (case-sensitive), e.g. "Example Realm".

houseSource.description: How `house` was decided: the auctioneer's own faction, a neutral town (Booty Bay, Gadgetzan, Everlook), or only the scanning character's faction (low confidence).

scannedAt.description: When the scan finished. A newer scannedAt for the same house replaces the older document.

complete.description: True only when every queued item answered (and the scan was not stopped).

method.description: full: the whole-AH download (ReplicateItems). search: one search per item. Left out when unknown: prices recorded before KutzInventory 1.3.0 and moved to this house (those documents also have houseSource "player" and leave out empty readings).

queued.description: Number of item IDs the scan meant to read: every listed item in a whole-house scan, or crafting materials/products minus unlimited vendor stock in a search.

answered.description: Items that got an answer (listed or none listed).

scope.description: all: the whole-AH download, every item (/kinv ah). Only when complete is true, an item missing from `items` was not listed at scannedAt and a reader may clear its older price. Incomplete scans leave absent items unknown. crafting: only the uploader's crafting items; a missing item is unknown. Absent (1.0.x documents): treat as crafting.

supply.description: 1.2: current buyout stacks [exact stack copper, units per stack, identical stack count, item variant]. Empty variant is fungible; gear keeps its item string or unknown. Complete means every eligible buyout was read; no sellers or history.

p.description: Up to the 3 lowest unit prices in copper, cheapest first (positive integers). Empty: searched and none listed. Always the same length as q.

q.description: The quantity at each of those prices, same order and length as p.

n.description: Result rows seen: listings for a full download, price rows for a search. A rough depth signal, not a count of auctions.

t.description: When this item was read. Receivers should validate timestamps against their own clock and acceptance policy.

c.description: The item's class ID (C_Item.GetItemInfoInstant), which the game's AH categories are built from. Optional.

s.description: The item's subclass ID within c. Optional.

name.description: The item's name as the game showed it in the whole-AH download (plain text). Optional; never a seller's name.

e.description: For gear: the item's equip slot token from C_Item.GetItemInfoInstant (e.g. INVTYPE_HEAD, INVTYPE_CHEST), which the game's AH uses to split Armor by slot. Optional; absent for items that are not worn.
